You will prepare complex proposals, build and justify project budgets, support both pre-award and post-award activities, and ensure compliance with sponsored research guidelines and institutional policies. Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst supports GIS data management, analysis, and process improvement initiatives in a utility-focused environment. In this role, you analyze spatial and tabular data, perform data conversions and migrations, maintain and enhance GIS databases, and develop solutions for data integrations and transformations. You conduct advanced GIS analysis, QA/QC, application testing, reporting, map creation, and automation using tools such as ArcGIS Pro, Model Builder, and Python. You work closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs, improve workflows, and support ongoing GIS initiatives that are critical to utility infrastructure. Responsibilities Edit, update, and maintain GIS datasets to ensure accuracy and consistency across the utility GIS environment. Perform GIS data analysis and data mining to support operational decision-making and project planning. Process and convert spatial and tabular data from various sources into GIS formats suitable for analysis and mapping. Conduct QA/QC checks on GIS data prior to production use to ensure data integrity and reliability. Support database maintenance activities, including data loading, updates, and structure optimization for GIS applications. Create specialized queries, maps, and reports tailored to stakeholder requirements and project objectives. Analyze existing GIS-related processes and workflows, and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and data quality. Support application testing and documentation for GIS tools, integrations, and workflows. Work independently on multiple GIS assignments, managing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and other GIS professionals, to support utility GIS initiatives. Apply linear referencing techniques to locate and manage pipeline and utility assets based on stationing and distance measures along linear features. Utilize Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate routine GIS tasks and streamline data processing. Contribute to modernization efforts and process improvements by leveraging advanced Esri technologies and best practices in geospatial data management. Advanced proficiency with ArcGIS Pro, including editing, analysis, and map production capabilities. Hands-on experience with linear referencing systems (LRS), including practical application for locating assets along linear features. Strong skills in GIS data analysis, QA/QC, and database maintenance within an enterprise GIS context. Experience with Python scripting and/or Model Builder to automate GIS workflows and data processing tasks. Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Working primarily on second shift, you will prepare and analyze samples, maintain a clean and organized laboratory, monitor and care for equipment, and assist with inventory and quality-related duties. Responsibilities Perform analytical and microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, and environmental samples in accordance with approved methods and protocols. Apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to evaluate indicator organisms, pathogens, and relevant chemistries. Prepare and analyze samples for indicator organisms, pathogens, and chemical parameters, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation. Notify laboratory management promptly of any deviations, out-of-specification results, or unusual findings in test results. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Provide routine preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and thorough cleaning of laboratory equipment to ensure reliable operation. Support quality-related duties, including performing temperature checks, monitoring controls, and verifying proper storage conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and customer requirements while following relevant regulatory and industry guidelines. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment using proper aseptic techniques and good laboratory practices. Stay current with scientific literature, emerging technologies, and industry trends related to food microbiology and analytical testing. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Hands-on experience with microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, or environmental samples. Proficiency in aseptic sampling techniques and routine laboratory procedures. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Working knowledge of OSHA safety requirements in a laboratory environment. Experience with FDA, BAM, APHA, ISO, or USP methods relevant to microbiology or analytical testing. Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail

Job Title: Quality Control Analyst Job Description The Quality Control Analyst will perform routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality specifications. This role is vital in maintaining the integrity and safety of products through meticulous testing and documentation. Responsibilities Conduct routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products. Perform Ph and moisture testing, density measurements, chemical titrations, and allergen testing. Monitor critical control points and support food safety programs. Job Title: Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance Job Description The Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance will join a dynamic Quality Assurance team as a contractor, with primary responsibility for document control and training activities and the potential to support additional QA functions as needed. This role works cross-functionally to ensure robust quality systems, accurate documentation, and effective training programs that support a regulated biopharmaceutical environment. Responsibilities Work effectively and collaboratively across multiple functional areas to fulfill Quality Assurance document control and training responsibilities. Provide administrative support in Learning Management and Document Management Systems, including data entry, record maintenance, and system updates as needed. Support the controlled document revision process by performing Quality Assurance Document Control (QADC) review in the electronic document management system. Maintain, organize, and control the document room and other document storage areas to ensure secure and compliant document handling. Issue, reconcile, and store controlled documents and logbooks, ensuring accurate tracking and traceability in accordance with good documentation practices. Organize, facilitate, and execute the archival process for controlled documents when required, ensuring proper long-term storage and retrieval. Support the training program by creating training content as needed, organizing and structuring training assignments, and processing new training requests. Provide additional support within the Quality organization, including assistance with corrections, GDP compliance, new hire training, and quality-related training activities. Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, quality control, and other teams to support batch record review, QC test form management, and document control review. Work within electronic quality and document systems such as Veeva, and leverage experience with similar platforms like MasterControl and TrackWise to manage documentation and training records. Print documents, create and manage document issuance, receiving, and reconciliation in the system, and perform thorough review of every document for document control compliance. Support organizations outside of Quality when needed, providing quality-focused guidance on documentation, training, and compliance. Adhere to and promote Good Documentation Practices (GDP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and relevant quality standards in all activities. Follow SOPs and quality procedures rigorously while demonstrating initiative and the ability to reprioritize tasks in a fast-paced, changing environment.
